title: HackDataV2 Scores
description: Schema for the evaluation/scores.json artifact written by the Evaluator component.

run_id.description: Timestamp-based run identifier matching the Artifacts/ folder name.

status.description: pending while Evaluator runs; partial if some pillars are done; done when all four are scored.

fidelity.description: 0–100 KS/TVD/correlation score vs. real data (null in query mode).

utility.description: 0–100 TSTR/TRTS score; null in query mode.

privacy.description: 0–100 exact-match / nearest-neighbour distance score; null in query mode.

overall.description: Weighted aggregate of the four pillars using EVAL_WEIGHTS.

weights.description: Copy of EVAL_WEIGHTS used when computing overall (echo for reproducibility).

details.description: Metric-level breakdown: KS distances, RF scores, NN ratios, etc.
